Lina: Quick sync — we shipped v1.2 last week. Need to decide next sprint mix: bugs vs enhancements. My initial thought: prioritize customer-blocking bugs but keep 1–2 small value bets. Thoughts?
Marcus: +1. Can we be explicit on capacity? I have 25 dev days total (across eng). If we reserve 8 days for oncall / stability, that leaves ~17 dev days.
Priya: Customer signal: 9 active tickets in the last 48h, 3 marked P1 (payment & streaming). Also seeing repeated asks for faster file uploads from 2 customers.
Omar: Ops note — we saw a spike in streaming errors after the rollout. Quick query:
```sql
SELECT error_type, count(*) FROM infra_errors WHERE service = 'streaming' AND ts > now() - interval '48 hours' GROUP BY error_type ORDER BY count DESC;
```
Top result is "kv-cache-miss" and a steady 3% tail latency increase.
Jen: QA bandwidth: we can cover 2 medium bug fixes + 1 small enhancement with full regression, or 4 small fixes with smoke tests only. End-to-end suites take 2 days each.
Nora: Design-wise, the upload flow regression looks like a small UX tweak (padding + loading state). Should be low effort but high visibility.
Marcus: Proposal: pull 3 engineering tickets — 2 infra fixes (kv cache + retry logic), 1 customer-facing bug (payment failure). Then pick 1 small UX enhancement (upload flow) + 1 quality-of-life enhancement (faster retry UX). That maps to ~16 dev days.
Lina: Sounds reasonable. For prioritization, let's gate by impact: P1 bugs first, then loss of revenue, then UX friction. Keep one enhancement as a canary A/B.
Priya: Assignments: I'll own the payment ticket follow-up with @Marcus for the backend trace. I'll ping the affected customers with ETA.
Marcus: I'll take kv-cache and retry refactor. ETA: 5 dev days.
Omar: I'll own the infra rollout + monitor. I'll add a short-lived metric and an alert: 2%+ tail latency for streaming => page.
Jen: I'll block 3 days for full regression on the infra changes, and 1 day for the upload UX check.
Nora: I'll prototype the upload state changes today, can handoff by EOD.
release-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2024-10-12T09:00:00Z -> channel=prod-canary. If error rate > 2% for 30m, auto-rollback enabled. :gear:
Lina: Decision: ship hotfix sprint. Scope = 3 high-priority fixes + 1 canary enhancement + QA regression. If anything slips, we drop the secondary enhancement.
Marcus: I'll create the sprint slice and label tickets: [bugfix-hot, canary-enhance]. Will post the sprint board link shortly.
Priya: I'll prepare customer comms template and alert CS.
Lina: Thanks. Quick follow-ups: Marcus please post estimates in the next 2 hours. Jen, confirm regression schedule by EOD. Omar, confirm alerting hooks by EOD. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
